review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 retain their stable keys and cover live, read-only wrapper counts, queue-clearing boundaries, and compatibility with the existing limiter. The source evidence supports the exact binding scope: index.js owns the wrapper implementation, index.d.ts directly maintains its exported return type, and test.js plus index.test-d.ts own runtime and compile-time regressions. package.json confirms the stated xo && ava && tsd verification entry point. The implementation/independent-verification task split and verification dependency are consistent with the specification. Neither task has an eligible execution member: the sole project member is a non-autoassignable reviewer without execution capability claims. That reviewer can satisfy the supplied earlier independent-review prerequisite without becoming an implementer or verifier, so reaching assignments and blocking both tasks with abstained-no-eligible is appropriate. No unresolved material business Decision is present in this case. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct source-manifest, evaluation-source, and normalized PRD digest domains. I rely on the Service's stated mechanical binding of these digests; I did not recompute hashes or execute code. The isolation evidence distinguishes retained historical operations from this bundle and supplies no candidate outputs. Approval concerns the pre-candidate Gold expectation only, not task dispatch, execution success, or completion of the remaining fresh negative controls.
